hero.title: Holix AI
hero.subtitle: Local First · Extensible · Auditable
hero.description: A cross-platform desktop AI application based on Electron, unified management of multiple model providers, upgrading AI from chat to intelligent assistant that can execute tasks through Skills mechanism

multiModel.title: Multi-Model Integration
multiModel.description: Built-in Provider management, support OpenAI, Anthropic, Google GenAI, Ollama and more, flexible switching per conversation

localFirst.title: Local-First Storage
localFirst.description: Chat data persisted to local database (LibSQL + Drizzle), fully retaining context, suitable for long-term project conversations

skills.title: Skills System
skills.description: Support built-in and user-defined Skills, including JavaScript tools, command-line tools, external scripts, auto-reload

approval.title: Tool Call Approval
approval.description: High-risk tool calls require approval before execution, support once-only and always-allow policies, enhancing security and auditability

desktop.title: Desktop Experience
desktop.description: System tray, window management, single instance, auto-update (electron-updater), i18n multi-language support

architecture.title: Engineering Architecture
architecture.description: React + TanStack Router + TypeScript, modular services, tRPC, with complete unit test system

whyChoose.title: Why Choose Holix AI
whyChoose.subtitle: Not just an AI chat tool, but a productivity-oriented AI client infrastructure

localControl.title: Strong Local Control
localControl.description: Data, configuration, and skills are all controllable on your machine, privacy and security guaranteed

extensible.title: Highly Extensible
extensible.description: Inject new capabilities through Skills, rather than waiting for official feature releases

securityBoundary.title: Clear Security Boundaries
securityBoundary.description: High-risk tool approval + call records, suitable for real production environments

modelNeutral.title: Model Neutral
modelNeutral.description: Not locked to a single provider, easy to switch strategies and optimize costs

desktopExperience.title: Stable Desktop Experience
desktopExperience.description: More suitable for long-running workflows, not browser short sessions

cta.title: Get Started Now
cta.subtitle: Open Source, Free, Self-Hostable AI Workspace

download.title: Download Holix AI
download.subtitle: Choose the version for your operating system and start using the AI workspace
